title: finding(components): `toast` and `sonner` registry `inputs` omit `buttonVariant`, a key both the TS type declares and both renderers read — the designer/palette face cannot author it
body:
Filed by the spec@objectui PM seat (session `session_01V3hPr7riucnMfhcHY86Msd`, 2026-09-02) as the second narrow specimen split out of #4631 (three declared surfaces disagree), per that card's own instruction to file the narrow bug rather than re-grade the meta-card. Unassigned; routing is triage's (sibling narrow card: #7268, tooltip).

## Measured on `origin/main` `67dadd6`

| surface | `buttonVariant` |
|---|---|
| TS type | declared — `packages/types/src/feedback.ts:175` (toast) and `:255` (sonner) |
| renderer | read — `packages/components/src/renderers/feedback/toast.tsx:30`, `sonner.tsx:36` |
| registry meta `inputs` | **absent** from both components' `inputs` arrays |

So the key is real end-to-end (typed, honoured at render) but invisible to every consumer of the registry's `inputs` — the designer property panel, the palette, and the registry-vs-spec parity family (`registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts` and its per-block siblings judge `inputs`, so an omitted input is never judged). #6541 (closed) fixed the *mirror-vs-TS* shape disagreement for `SonnerSchema.buttonVariant`; the `inputs` omission is a different surface and survived it.

## Candidate resolution (not decided here)

Declare `buttonVariant` in both registries' `inputs` (`type: 'select'` over the six-token union the TS type carries), and let the existing inputs parity gates take it from there. If the maintainers consider `buttonVariant` a non-authorable prop, the opposite fix is to drop it from the TS type and the renderers — but the renderers read it today, so that direction is a behaviour change and would need its own ruling.

Refs: #4631 (the three-surface meta-card this came from; its `text` specimen is already resolved, `tooltip` is #7268) · #6541 (mirror/TS fix, closed).

Dedup: `search_issues` "toast sonner buttonVariant inputs registry declared read omitted" → only #6541 and #6347, both closed and about other surfaces (2026-09-02).
